change_log.change: Policy backend replaced with independently qualified Gemma 3 12B IT QAT Q4_0. Liquid LFM2.5-2.6B and LFM2.5-8B-A1B both failed policy qualification (UNQUALIFIED and EARLY_REJECT respectively). Gemma 3 12B passed all gates at 90% core accuracy.
unchanged: frozen_identities (benchmark, t2_definition, t2_r1_implementation, utility, extractor, action_vocabulary, prompt, statistical_method, equivalence_margin)

research_question: Does R1 (phase-conditioned representation routing) improve utility over A1 specifically on late-T2 tasks under Q3 retrieval?

cost_thresholds.Delta_Steps_T2+: mean <= 1.5 x Steps_A1 (unless utility improvement justifies)

promotion_criteria.cost: no catastrophic growth in steps, tokens, latency
promotion_criteria.generalization: at least 2 models show consistent directional benefit (for full promotion)

frozen_identities.benchmark: i3_15_t2_eligible (BENCHMARK_V2 with trigger-depth strata + matched controls)
frozen_identities.prompt: PROMPT_V2 (with SUFFICIENT/UNVERIFIED definitions and VERIFY-before-DEFER procedure)

backend_requirements.primary: LOCAL_POLICY_GEMMA3_12B_QAT_Q4 (google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-gguf via bartowski mirror) — frozen pinned model
backend_requirements.qualification: POLICY_QUALIFICATION_V2 (80 states, all gates passed: core=92%, DEFER=85%, ANSWER=100%, VERIFY=100%, RETRIEVE=85%, decoder=100%, len_fail=0%, asym=10pp)
backend_requirements.llama_cpp_version: 0.2.0-dev (build 1, commit d775b89), built with GNU 11.4.0 for Linux x86_64
backend_requirements.chat_template_sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 (empty — not exposed by llama-server /v1/models; chat template is embedded in GGUF, captured by gguf_sha256)
backend_requirements.reasoning_budget: NOT_APPLICABLE (validated: budgets 0/128/384 produce identical results, no reasoning_content produced, 20/20 action agreement across budgets)
backend_requirements.max_tokens_r9b: Selected via R9b: lowest ceiling with 100% decoder, 0 length failures, 100% action agreement vs reference (max_tokens=2048)
backend_requirements.note: Backend must pass POLICY_QUALIFICATION_V2 before entering frozen experiment. V1 used LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B which failed qualification.

preflight_checks: model identity matches protocol (Gemma 3 12B QAT Q4_0)
note: This protocol supersedes V1. The only change is the policy backend: Liquid LFM2.5-2.6B (UNQUALIFIED) is replaced by Gemma 3 12B IT QAT Q4_0 (QUALIFIED). All scientific design, hypotheses, contrasts, thresholds, and frozen identities are unchanged. This change occurs BEFORE R13 and does not contaminate the experiment.
